subject.title: fix(gateway): fail fast on missing local probe auth

question: Should local status commands fail closed before probing whenever configured gateway credentials cannot be resolved, or preserve the shipped probe attempt and report the auth diagnostic alongside its result?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically coherent, but the PR intentionally changes an upgrade-sensitive gateway/auth default, so repository policy requires owner intent.

options.title: Preserve probe default
options.body: Continue the local probe and surface the unresolved-auth diagnostic, reserving fail-fast for an explicit strict mode or later approved policy.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed default
options.body: Merge the immediate failure behavior and explicitly own the compatibility impact for existing configured-auth installations.

recommendation.title: Preserve probe default
recommendation.body: Continue the local probe and surface the unresolved-auth diagnostic, reserving fail-fast for an explicit strict mode or later approved policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway probe ownership and the shared auth-helper refactor make this the best available owner for the permanent probe/auth policy.
